capabilities: Run a setup wizard for title, word goal, and timeframe
Create a novel folder with Dashboard.md and a Chapters folder
Count chapter words live while typing
Show progress rings, streaks, daily average, and projected finish date
Chart total over time, words per day, and hours written
extras: Privacy section states no network requests, accounts, ads, or telemetry; settings and writing history live in the plugin's data.json, and each device gets a random ID in Obsidian's local storage so synced devices do not overwrite each other's history. Word counting excludes frontmatter, comments, code, math, link targets, and Markdown symbols; Chinese and Japanese count one word per character. Deleting text never lowers words today, and a configurable writing-day start hour lets late-night sessions count toward the previous day. README also notes it is not affiliated with NaNoWriMo.
intentEvidence: Inspired by the novel stats page of NaNoWriMo (National Novel Writing Month), which closed in 2025.
motivation: The README says the dashboard is modeled on the old NaNoWriMo novel stats page, which closed in 2025, and the plugin is built for the 50,000-words-in-a-month challenge.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to set a manuscript word-count goal and see daily progress, streaks, or a projected finish date while writing a long work.

relations.evidence: Inspired by the novel stats page of NaNoWriMo (National Novel Writing Month), which closed in 2025.

summary: Novel word-count tracker that creates a per-novel folder and a live dashboard of daily progress, streaks, and projected finish date.
